Signups chart with a Week/Month toggle. Week: Mon-Sun 30, 42, 38, 51, 47, 22, 18. Month: weeks 1-4 210, 245, 230, 268.
Product table with a search box that filters by name as you type, and a count of matching rows: Notebook $4, Pen $2, Pencil $1, Backpack $35, Ruler $3, Marker $5, Paper pack $8, Pen case $9.

Sign-up form with name, email, a plan choice (Free, Pro, Team) and an 'I agree to the terms' checkbox. The submit button only works when name and email are filled and the box is ticked; after submitting, show 'Welcome, <name>!'.
To-do list starting with 'Buy milk' (done) and 'Call mom' (not done). People can add items, tick them off, and remove them. Show how many are left.
Mortgage calculator with loan amount ($300,000), interest rate (6.5%) and term (30 years) controls. Show the monthly payment using the standard amortization formula, updating as controls change.

Personal spending tracker. Expenses: Groceries Food $82; Gas Transport $45; Dinner out Food $64; Movie Fun $18; Bus pass Transport $30. Show total spent, a donut of spending by category, and a form to add an expense (name, category from Food/Transport/Fun, amount) that updates the total and the donut.
